assumptions.text: The Moon has no atmosphere; atmospheric refraction, scattering, and twilight are strictly zero.
The Moon's reference figure is a sphere of radius 1,737,400 meters.
Ephemeris states are tabulated at uniform 3-hour intervals from JPL DE440 and interpolated with cubic Catmull-Rom splines.
